title: The black mailbox began as a vague landmark
summary: Bob Lazar tells of The black mailbox began as a vague landmark, about 1989 at black mailbox, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, I just said, "It's around the black mailbox."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site around 1989, tells podcast host Jesse Michels how a desert spot became famous. He says that when people asked where to watch for the craft, he just told them it was "around the black mailbox," a mailbox on a lonely Nevada road. As he tells it, that loose landmark is how the mailbox became a gathering place for sky watchers.
